rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for food that tastes of salt.

example.english: The soup is too salty, so I did not want another sip.
example.traditional: 碗湯太鹹，我飲一啖就唔想再飲喇。
example.jyutping: wun2 tong1 taai3 haam4 ngo5 jam2 jat1 daam6 zau6 m4 soeng2 zoi3 jam2 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a person who is irritated or angry, where English “salty” describes an upset attitude rather than food.

example.english: He was so salty after losing the game; he is really petty.
example.traditional: 佢輸咗場波仲咁嬲，真係小器。
example.jyutping: keoi5 syu1 zo2 coeng4 bo1 zung6 gam3 nau1 zan1 hai6 siu2 hei3

rows.note: Use this for coarse or vulgar language and behaviour, rather than for someone who is merely annoyed.

example.english: The jokes on this show are too salty for children.
example.traditional: 呢個節目啲笑話太粗俗，唔啱細路睇。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zit3 muk6 di1 siu3 waa2 taai3 cou1 zuk6 m4 ngaam1 sai3 lou6 tai2
